environment.description: Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. The user-profile-service runs in namespace 'backend-services' with automatic sidecar injection (istio-injection=enabled). PeerAuthentication resource in the namespace enforces STRICT mTLS mode. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied with the following spec: action DENY for source principals not matching 'cluster.local/ns/backend-services/sa/*' — effectively rejecting any traffic originating from workloads outside the 'backend-services' namespace. A second AuthorizationPolicy with action ALLOW requires request.headers['x-internal-role'] to be absent OR source.principal to match 'cluster.local/ns/backend-services/sa/admin-gateway'. EnvoyFilter at namespace level strips x-internal-role and x-caller-namespace headers from any inbound request where the downstream peer certificate SAN does not contain 'admin-gateway' service account.
